description: Three rays of fire, each a separate ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire damage. One more ray for each slot level above 2nd.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd.
srd_description:
You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several.
Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage.
